summary: American Assets Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Voting Support Agreement with its controlling stockholder, the Rady Trust Group, and amendments to its charter's ownership limits. The board increased the excepted holder limit for the Rady Group from 19.9% to 21.9% and lowered the aggregate and common stock ownership limits to 6.775%. This is a routine governance matter to maintain REIT qualification by preventing concentrated ownership from triggering tax issues. No transaction, premium, price, or timeline is involved. No special-situation event is present.
